searchText: 900+ gas wow Do we not have an MEV mitigation channel? Not currently. But you can chat here, tag flashbots group and others who may be interested, and we can open a new channel if others are interested I'm curious about the mean and variance of # of blocks proposed by single entity given the distribution of stakers. The last participant has a measure of control over that process, as they can either include or not their contribution. Commit/reveal is an option, but a fair amount of effort. VDF seems to be the way that the thinking is going for randomness. Commit reveal is only as secure as the bond for not revealing, and it is only paid when an attacker succeeds. Also, multiple parties can collude to further decrease security and they only eat the bond cost once when the collusion succeeds.
